0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, 8th in the East, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, on a two-game winning streak) in the Wizards' 9th game of the season and the Emirates NBA Cup East Group C. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). Atlanta won the last meeting 120-105 in Washington, and the Wizards trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 1-3 in 2025-26.
